_spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil A.5 asset mapping and A.6 Trade-Republic gate.

tr_gate.note: Per A.6, Trade Republic tradability is NOT a research filter. Research defines instruments by index + fund structure + tax class. A TRADABILITY_BLOCKED result blocks implementation, never the analysis.

DIVIDEND.note: Reclassified from direct_stocks to equity_fund. This reclassification is what removes the last direct_stocks instrument from the universe and thereby makes B.1 (withholding tax credit) NOT_IN_DECISION_PATH.

GOLD.note: Tax treatment is a first-class assumption per B.3 and MUST be reported under both variants.

COMMOD.note: tax_class is a PLACEHOLDER. A broad commodity vehicle is very unlikely to qualify as an equity fund; correct classification is required before COMMOD is ever quantified. COMMOD is INDETERMINATE_BY_CONSTRUCTION under G1 in any case.
